scope: Generated DXF VIEWPORT direct layer-override reference transport for group codes 335, 343 and 344.

sources.title: Autodesk VIEWPORT DXF reference
sources.finding: The VIEWPORT-specific table identifies codes 335, 343 and 344 as soft-pointer references to VIEWPORT objects for layer VP property overrides. The same table identifies code 91 as a soft pointer.

sources.title: Autodesk DXF group-code ranges
sources.finding: The generic table classifies codes 90-99 as int32, 330-339 as soft pointers and 340-349 as hard pointers. This conflicts with the VIEWPORT-specific meaning for code 91 and pointer roles for 343/344; the context-specific VIEWPORT table provides the implemented roles for 335/343/344, while code 91 remains fail-closed.

sources.title: Autodesk DxfCode reference
sources.finding: DXF code meanings are contextual; identical integer codes can have different meanings in different record contexts. This supports keeping VIEWPORT entity fields separate from Layer-owned XRECORD payload tags.

research.separation: The generated ezdxf-described Layer-owned XRECORD profile remains separate: its group 335 is a VIEWPORT handle, group 343 is an LTYPE handle, and group 91 is lineweight data. This implementation applies only to the direct VIEWPORT entity fields.

implementation.model: Retain ordered code/64-bit-handle pairs, bounded to 512 entries; parse DXF hexadecimal handle lexemes; refuse code 91; refuse encoding these DXF-only fields through the DWG VIEWPORT encoder.
implementation.writer: Translate references through the adapter resolver or preallocated/remapped entity identity. The adapter preallocates forward target identities before writing and binds emitted VIEWPORT identities. Graph validation requires one unique retained VIEWPORT target for each edge.

validation.input: Generated in-memory VIEWPORT graph and locally authored parser strings; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
validation.result: PASS. Parser controls retain ordered codes 335/343/344 and refuse code 91. Low-level writer controls verify remapped values. Adapter controls verify forward references resolve to the output VIEWPORT identity after ASCII/Binary readback; a LINE target is refused with destination preservation, then the same adapter succeeds after correction.

qualification_limits: Generated transport and graph-closure evidence only; no eligible physical producer carrying these direct VIEWPORT fields was available.
Does not qualify native layer override activation, rendering, dictionary-key collation, or wider producer/version coverage.
Group 91 remains unmodeled and refused until its DXF value representation and binary encoding are independently resolved.
The local AC1024 corpus census found no such fields and therefore supplies no producer corroboration.
No support claim is promoted by this receipt.
